title: Read scheduled and confirmed production without advancing balances early
description: A developer inspects the shipped CampaignEconomy component with the existing production-reducer lab scenario. Seeking is an explicit presentation harness, not authenticated production delivery, catch-up, authorization or conservation evidence. Standard and reduced motion retain identical facts; predecessor service and lab assertions remain intact.

steps.description: Freeze only browser playback. Existing shared reducers supply the declared component scenario; no service clock, live account or persisted campaign is replaced.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Open production before the first deadline and inspect the unchanged starting balance.
steps.acknowledgement: Both production schedules report “Next production:” with identical text.
verifications: Both motion panes retain exactly 200 available credits.
Neither due time nor motion mode invents a confirmed tick or production ledger.
